fact: On 3 October 2026 Bank Al-Maghrib and the Central Bank of the UAE signed an MoU to explore interlinking instant payment platforms, national card switches and messaging systems, and cross-border use of CBDCs between the two countries.
title: CBUAE and Bank Al-Maghrib sign two MoUs to strengthen supervisory cooperation and Islamic finance and interlink payment systems
publisher: Central Bank of the UAE / Bank Al-Maghrib
